$schema-note: Bundled public API reference prices in USD per million tokens. Subscription aliases estimate equivalent API usage. The Go bundle is generated from this file.

notes.anthropic:sonnet-5-intro: Sonnet 5 uses the current standard $2 input and $10 output rate; the introductory rate became the standard price, verified in the Anthropic pricing and Sonnet 5 migration guide on 2026-09-03.
notes.anthropic:opus-tier: claude-opus-4-5 through claude-opus-5 stay on the lower 5/25 Opus tier.
notes.anthropic:opus-legacy: claude-opus-4-1 / claude-opus-4 are the pre-4.5 Opus tier (legacy, still served at the original price).
notes.anthropic:sonnet-4: claude-sonnet-4 is deprecated; same price as the 4.x family.
notes.anthropic:haiku-3-5: Defensive entry for the rare runtime still on the older Haiku tier.
notes.openai:codex-generations: Each Codex generation (gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5-codex, the gpt-5.x rows) is priced independently - no fallback to gpt-5. Entries track server/pkg/agent/models.go.
notes.openai:gpt-5.6: Verified against the OpenAI model pages on 2026-09-03: Sol 4/20, Terra 2/12 and Luna 0.2/1.2 USD per million input/output tokens. Cached input is 0.1x input and cache writes are 1.25x input. Sol promotional rates are available at least through 2026-11-21. The aggregate estimate uses the standard context tier; provider-reported charges take precedence.
notes.deepseek:v4-pro: deepseek-v4-pro was under a 75%-off promo that ended 2026-05-31 15:59 UTC; priced at the post-promo standard rate ($1.74 / $3.48) so the dashboard doesn't jump 4x when the promo ends - a brief over-estimate during the promo was accepted over a sudden cliff after it.
notes.deepseek:aliases: deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner are aliases that route to deepseek-v4-flash (non-thinking / thinking mode) per DeepSeek's pricing page.
notes.moonshot:k2.6: Only K2.6 is on Moonshot's official K2 price sheet; earlier K2 variants are intentionally omitted until Moonshot publishes their rates.
notes.moonshot:k3: Kimi K3 uses Moonshot's published $3 cache-miss input, $0.30 cache-hit input, and $15 output rates per million tokens. Moonshot publishes no separate cache-write rate, so cacheWrite mirrors cache-miss input. kimi/k3 is the provider-qualified key reported by Kimi Code CLI.
notes.zhipu:free-tiers: Free flash tiers (glm-4.7-flash, glm-4.5-flash) are priced at 0 so they resolve cleanly instead of falling through to the unmapped diagnostic.
notes.alibaba:qwen3: qwen3.7-plus and qwen3.6-flash use Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's International <=256K tier. Explicit cache creation is 1.25x input and explicit cache read is 10% of input. qwen3.8-max uses its published pay-as-you-go rate, including the published explicit cache rates.
notes.alibaba:qwen3.8-max-preview: qwen3.8-max-preview is a legacy subscription ID without a trustworthy USD/token conversion; it is deliberately unmapped rather than encoded as zero or aliased to qwen3.8-max.
notes.volcengine:ark-code-latest: ark-code-latest is a rolling alias whose target can switch between model families; it is deliberately unmapped because the daemon reports the alias rather than the resolved model.
notes.xai:grok: grok-* rows are the short-context tier and only a FALLBACK: xAI reports its own price per turn and estimateCost prefers it (xAI bills a request at 2x once its prompt reaches 200K tokens, which aggregated rows cannot express). cacheRead is xAI's published Cached input rate; there is no separate cache-write rate, so cacheWrite mirrors input. grok ids are vendor-prefixed, so these keys stay unqualified - the daemon tags rows with provider 'grok', not 'xai'.
notes.xai:grok-composer: grok-composer-* ships in the Grok Build catalog (server/pkg/agent/models.go) but is absent from the price sheet; deliberately unmapped rather than inheriting a guessed rate.
notes.cursor:keys: Cursor's model ids are unprefixed generic names (auto, composer-*) that collide across providers, so they are provider-qualified under cursor/. See the provider-qualified keys note in runtimes/utils.ts.
notes.cursor:cache-write: Cursor publishes no cache-write rate for these rows; cacheWrite stays 0 so reported cache_write_tokens don't invent spend from input pricing.
notes.cursor:legacy: cursor (bare) is the legacy fallback bucket when neither the result event nor the runtime model is known; the key equals the provider name itself so it cannot collide across providers. Priced at the current Composer 2.5 Fast default.
notes.anthropic:fable-5-1: Preserved from the upstream catalog: Fable 5.1 uses $10 input, $50 output, $0.25 cache read and $12.50 cache write per million tokens.
